| # Object 0x1005 COB-ID SYNC message {#object-0x1005-cob-id-sync-message-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}                                                                                                                                                                                          |                                                                                                                                                                        |
+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

The device generates a SYNC message if bit 30 is set.

 

  Index           0x1005
  --------------- --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Name            COB-ID SYNC message
  Object          VAR
  Data Type       UNSIGNED 32
  Category        Conditional; Mandatory if PDO communication on a synchronous base is supported
  Access          RW
  PDO Mapping     No
  Value Range     UNSIGNED 32
  Default Value   8000 0080h
